name: 86 Chaos 16.0.46 Release Gate Cascade Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.46 Release Gate Cascade Fix
notes: Release-gate blockers were hardened: Firestore diagnostics cache shape, crash-report dedupe, schedule time validation, accessibility harness fallback, and local Play Store runner recovery.
releaseNotes: Firestore diagnostics now self-heals stale or partial listener/cache buckets before reading dynamic query keys, preventing the undefined users-cache crash seen in release-gate route crawls.
Automatic crash reports now suppress known non-fatal Firebase Messaging unsupported-browser errors server-side and dedupe identical crash reports within a short window.
Schedule time validation now treats 18-hour-or-longer shifts like 4p-10a as invalid unless a future explicit business setting says otherwise.
Schedule Builder displays full staff names in the planning grid and keeps event labels readable with full titles plus times.
Request-off cards and partial-day chips now show safe readable dates/times instead of Invalid Date when a legacy partial record is incomplete.
System Administrator routing accepts server-verified super-admins plus local system administrator markers while keeping normal staff/manager gates intact.
The accessibility release gate can run with the existing axe-core package even when @axe-core/playwright is not installed.
The missing RUN_86CHAOS_PLAY_STORE_RELEASE_GATE.ps1 runner is restored so npm run test:play-store can start the local release gate.
Firebase Messaging now checks browser support before push token sync or foreground message listeners run.
Known messaging/unsupported-browser errors are no longer reported as Crash / Error bug notifications.
Unsupported push sessions now save a quiet push status of unsupported-browser instead of breaking the app or spamming admins.
Manual push repair now shows Push Unavailable when the browser cannot support Firebase Messaging.
The real app still uses Firebase Messaging on supported browsers and devices.
86Voice 86/out-of-stock commands now resolve unique live inventory products from short spoken phrases while still asking for review when multiple products match.
86Voice prep updates now use fuzzy existing-row matching, so “prep ranch” can update an existing “Fill Ranch Bottles” row instead of creating a duplicate.
Menu impact and AI ordering voice paths now use richer inventory aliases including category, vendor, SKU/code, pack size, alternate names, and keywords.
My Schedule now shows only current and upcoming shifts for the selected month instead of dimming old ended shifts in the employee list.
Schedule Builder Auto-Fill now fetches the full selected source month before copying shifts, so weeks outside the current visible planning window are not silently skipped.
Auto-Fill still skips true duplicates but can now fill missing target dates on a retry after a partial copy.

Auto-Fill falls back to the original source-shift identity when a roster match is unavailable, reducing false invalid skips for legacy imported schedules that were already visible in the source month.
Client Jest setup now includes the web API and Firebase Messaging mocks needed for the local client smoke tests.
